caption: Step 2 of 3 of the MeetGeek onboarding, Capture: the heading Point us at your meetings with Connect buttons for Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar (not clicked), the choice How should we capture meetings with Send an Agent (joins the call as a guest) and Record without a Bot (record locally from your desktop), an empty agent setting, Other recording options, and the buttons Back, Continue without calendar and Continue. The picture on the right is a sample calendar. No account detail is on this screen.

The Uploads page right after the file testmeeting.m4a (174.1 KB) was chosen: the upload box says Works best with mp4, mp3, wav. Max 4h per recording. Processing takes 10-15 mins depending on the size of the recording. Under it are Meeting language Auto-detect, Meeting template General meeting and the switch Send summary email, which was switched off before the upload. The list shows testmeeting.m4a with the status Analyzing and the upload date 18th Nov 2026, 08:45. The avatar at the top right is covered.

The meeting page Harbor Lights Launch Readiness (Wed, 18 Nov 2026, 08:45 to 08:46) on the tab Conversation: the transcript shows two speakers, Speaker_01 and Speaker_00, with time stamps (00:00:06, 00:00:14 and 00:00:23), who talk about two open bugs on a payment page, a pricing proposal to be sent by Monday, a budget check, a budget of twelve thousand euros and a final review meeting. The speaker labels are not linked to names. The chat panel Chat with MeetGeek is open on the right and a banner offers the meetings inside Claude and ChatGPT. The avatar at the top right is covered.

The same meeting page on the tab Summary: a Meeting Summary of a short planning meeting (launch date Friday, 12 December, two bugs on the payment page to be fixed by Wednesday, 10 December, a pricing proposal by Monday, 8 December, a budget check with the budget stated as 12,000 euros and a final review on Thursday, 11 December) and a list Next Steps with, per item, an owner and a deadline and a link to the time in the recording. A Regenerate summary button sits in the tab bar. The avatar at the top right is covered.
